name: pdf-card-mcp
description: Convert local PDFs into standalone, readable card-based HTML pages with embedded table and figure images.
long_description: PDF Card Reader is a local-first MCP tool for turning dense PDFs into calm, minimal HTML readers. It keeps text local, renders source pages, crops detected tables and figures as images, and writes a standalone HTML file that can be moved across devices.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_card_html
tools.description: Convert a local PDF into a standalone card-based HTML reader with embedded table and figure images.
